shadows.name: compact-menu
shadows.purpose: Transient capture and actions menu only. Persistent workspaces are flat.

motion.name: state-easing
motion.purpose: State transitions when reduced motion is not requested.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Open the evidence behind a change.
components.css: .ds-primary{min-height:32px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:6px;font:510 12px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;background:var(--mist,#eeeeee);color:var(--void,#101010);border:1px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee)}.ds-primary:hover{background:#d8d5d2}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-search:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-chip:focus-visible,.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary,.ds-secondary,.ds-nav button{transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1),border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1)}}

components.description: A supporting action beside the primary evidence action.

components.name: Selected connection
components.description: A process and destination row whose selection is tied to the map.
components.css: .ds-row{position:relative;display:grid;gap:7px;min-height:112px;width:100%;padding:14px 16px;text-align:left;background:#292522;color:var(--mist,#eeeeee);border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--graphite,#3d3a39);font:14px Geist,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-row:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:#ee6018}.ds-row strong{font-size:15px}.ds-row code{font:12px "Geist Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}.ds-row span{font-size:12px;color:var(--fog,#b8b3b0)}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-secondary:focus-visible,.ds-search:focus-visible,.ds-nav button:focus-visible,.ds-chip:focus-visible,.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--selection,#eeeeee);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
Axvaris presents network evidence in a restrained desktop workspace. Factory and Gotham are the confirmed references for its serious observability character. Warm dark panels, quiet dividers and readable text separate controls from connection evidence. The globe shares the workspace with the feed; evidence remains available when a destination cannot be plotted.

The serif AXVARIS wordmark supplies the identity. Interface text uses Geist and technical values use Geist Mono. Motion responds to an action or a data change. Continuous decorative particles and pulsing chrome have no role in this design.
keyCharacteristics: Five persistent investigation areas in a left sidebar.
Monochrome controls with limited color for evidence states.
Larger values and row names above quieter metadata.
Local brand and font assets, with no remote font dependency.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Use color to identify a capture or evidence state. Keep general navigation and actions monochrome.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied serif wordmark and its matching X. Do not add a crossing line or reconstruct the logo with a system font.

rules.name: The Panel Rule
rules.body: Separate persistent panels with their background and edge. Reserve shadows for transient overlays that already use them.

dos: Do use the supplied serif AXVARIS wordmark and matching X.
Do keep process names, evidence text and metric values stronger than metadata.
Do preserve the five-area sidebar and stacked compact Live layout.
Do keep visible focus, text labels for states and reduced motion behavior.
Do distinguish local capture, imported DNS queries and demo data in the interface.
donts: Don't add a crossing line, glow or neon accent to the brand assets.
Don't use continuous decorative particles or pulsing chrome.
Don't draw destinations without known coordinates.
Don't turn imported DNS queries into confirmed connections or remote process identities.
Don't describe the UI as certified accessible or resource-efficient without corresponding validation evidence.
